get.description: Newest first, `limit` 1–100 (default 20). Filter by `status`, by the `batch_id` that created the payout, or by a `created_from` / `created_before` window. Page with `starting_after` set to the last id of the previous page, and stop when `has_more` is false.

parameters.name: created_from
parameters.description: Only transfers created at or after this instant. RFC 3339; a bare date means midnight UTC. With `created_before` it forms a half-open window, so consecutive windows never count a transfer twice.

parameters.name: created_before
parameters.description: Only transfers created strictly before this instant. RFC 3339; a bare date means midnight UTC.

target_currency.description: Currency you receive. Supported pairs: NGN/USD, GHS/USD and USD/NGN.

base_currency.description: Currency you pay in. Supported pairs: NGN/USD, GHS/USD and USD/NGN.

target_currency.description: Currency you receive. Supported pairs: NGN/USD, GHS/USD and USD/NGN.

type.description: Payout corridor. `international_bank` pays USD, EUR or GBP to a bank account; `mobile_money` and `bank_account` pay a supported corridor; `stablecoin` sends USDT, USDC or RLUSD on-chain; `stablecoin_funding` tops up your own business wallet.

currency.description: Payout currency. The corridor decides which values are valid: USD/EUR/GBP for `international_bank`, the corridor currency for mobile money and bank transfers, USDT/USDC/RLUSD for stablecoins.

debit_currency.description: Currency debited from your wallet; may differ from `currency` only when a fiat wallet funds a stablecoin transfer.

has_more.description: Whether another page exists after this one (continue with `starting_after` set to the last id).

Error.description: The one error shape returned by every /v1 endpoint.

message.description: Human-readable explanation. Safe to log; not necessarily safe to show verbatim to end-users.

param.description: The request field the error refers to, when applicable.

RequestId.description: A UUID generated for this one request. Log it; support cannot investigate a failure without one.

IdempotentReplayed.description: Always present on an answer that went through the Idempotency-Key layer: `false` when this request ran now, `true` when the answer saved under the same key was replayed.

XRateLimitLimit.description: The request ceiling for the current window.

XRateLimitRemaining.description: Requests remaining in the current window.

CacheControl.description: Always `no-store`: account data, balances and hosted pages must never sit in a shared or browser cache.

IdempotencyStatusVersion.description: Always `1` today. Read it before parsing the other key headers, so a future version can add values without breaking you.

IdempotencyKeyState.description: The key's state after this answer: `completed` — the answer is saved and will be replayed; `pending` — another request with this key is still running; `failed` — the answer was a server error and the key was released, so the same key may be retried.

IdempotentOriginalAt.description: Present only on a replay: when the saved answer was stored (ISO 8601).

IdempotencyReference.description: Present only on a replay when the saved answer carried a receipt: its `reference`.
